title: Bone Grafting: Healing Time, Timeline and What to Expect
seoTitle: Bone Graft Healing Time: Stages and What to Expect
seoDescription: See how a bone graft heals, from soft tissue closure to implant-ready bone, and what can slow it. Get a case-specific timeline in Valencia.
excerpt: Gums close in weeks, but grafted bone takes months to mature. Here is the stage-by-stage timeline, what changes it, and when implants can go in.
keyTakeaways: Soft tissue usually seals over the graft in 7 to 28 days; the graft itself consolidates over 3 to 6 months.
Implant placement is commonly scheduled 3 to 9 months after grafting, depending on graft type and site.
Autografts tend to integrate fastest; xenografts and synthetics may take 4 to 9 months to consolidate.
Loose sutures or visible graft particles in the first two weeks are common and not automatically a failure.
Smoking, uncontrolled diabetes and some medications slow healing and raise the risk of graft failure.
